items.title: Hugging Face CEO Calls for 'Radical Transparency' After 'Unprecedented' OpenAI Hack
items.summary: The CEO of Hugging Face advocates for greater transparency in the AI industry following a significant security breach at OpenAI, highlighting concerns about data security and ethical practices.

items.title: Are Brain Waves the Next Unlock for Physical AI?
items.summary: This article explores the potential of integrating brainwave data to enhance physical AI systems, suggesting a novel direction for human-AI interaction and control.

items.title: An Exam for Active Observers
items.summary: New research introduces a novel framework for evaluating AI systems that actively observe and interact with their environment, pushing the boundaries of agentic AI assessment.

items.title: Making Sense of the Panic Over Chinese AI
items.summary: An analysis delves into the current anxieties surrounding China's advancements in artificial intelligence, examining the geopolitical and technological implications.

items.title: David Vélez and Robin Vince Join the Boards of the OpenAI Foundation and OpenAI Group PBC
items.summary: OpenAI announces the appointment of David Vélez and Robin Vince to its Foundation and Group PBC boards, signaling a strengthening of its leadership and governance.

items.title: Color Pass-Through via Camera-Display Coupling
items.summary: This paper presents a method for achieving realistic color pass-through in augmented reality systems by tightly integrating camera and display technologies.

items.title: Sample-Efficient Learning from Agent Experience
items.summary: Researchers explore techniques to improve the sample efficiency of AI agents, allowing them to learn more effectively from limited real-world or simulated experiences.

items.title: Scaling Laws for Hypernetwork-Based Knowledge Injection in Large Language Models
items.summary: A study investigates the scaling properties of hypernetworks for injecting new knowledge into large language models, offering insights into efficient model adaptation.

items.title: Generalizable VLA Finetuning via Representation Anchoring and Language-Action Alignment
items.summary: This paper proposes a finetuning approach for Vision-Language-Action models that enhances generalizability through robust representation anchoring and improved language-action alignment.

items.title: Beyond Euclidean Clipping: Overcoming Exploration Collapse in LLM RL via Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization
items.summary: New research introduces Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization to address exploration collapse in LLM reinforcement learning, enabling more stable and effective training.

items.title: DocOps: A Verifiable Benchmark for Autonomous Agents in Complex Document Operations
items.summary: A new benchmark, DocOps, is introduced to rigorously evaluate the performance and verifiability of autonomous AI agents tasked with complex document-based operations.

items.title: Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Molt is presented as a scalable, PyTorch-native framework designed to streamline the training of agentic reinforcement learning systems, facilitating complex AI development.

items.title: FVAttn: Adaptive Sparse Attention with Runtime Load Balancing for Video Generation
items.summary: This paper introduces FVAttn, an adaptive sparse attention mechanism with runtime load balancing, significantly improving efficiency for high-quality video generation models.

items.title: ATSplat: Compact Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Adaptive Token Expansion
items.summary: ATSplat offers a compact and efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting method using adaptive token expansion, enabling high-fidelity 3D scene representation with reduced computational cost.

items.title: FinanceComplexQA: Benchmarking Agentic Reasoning on Industrial-grade Financial Documents
items.summary: FinanceComplexQA is a new benchmark designed to evaluate the advanced reasoning capabilities of AI agents when processing and answering questions from complex, industrial-grade financial documents.
